question_construction: Four original immutable authenticated public source projects, each with vulnerable/fixed code x original/swap answer-slot order (16 source-present) and missing-source x original/swap answer-slot order (8 abstain): 24 tasks. Same neutral question and same two candidate statements across source versions. No version/role/commit/source URL/project metadata in exported candidate prompt.
primary_endpoint: Complete correct four-way paired counterfactual and answer-position reversal per project (0 to 4); strict source-present agreement (0 to 16) and no-source abstention (0 to 8) separately.
source_blind_attacker_model: Only model-visible prompt after replacing source code with SOURCE-HIDDEN; no metadata, original git references, candidate IDs, archives, or side channels. Can inspect neutral question and both candidate answer texts. Under this limited attacker definition, each project has the same code-omitted prompt content for both source revisions and labels change, so max eight of sixteen source-present matches and zero of four complete four-way reversals; eight no-source controls can trivially abstain.
metadata_sidechannel_limitation: Public code and original source commitment hashes make this open-book. A participant inspecting the public implementation, source URLs, or original question identifiers may recover references. The source-blind bound applies ONLY to the defined prompt-masked threat model, not arbitrary cheating, pretraining leakage or public provenance lookup.
frozen_prompt_system: You are reviewing a security claim against exact supplied source code. Return A or B only when the source code establishes one of the two options. If the necessary source code is missing, return ABSTAIN. Your answer must be exactly A, B, or ABSTAIN.
